scope: semi-automatic training-free interaction editing; no people, hands, mouths, or biting

methods.A_qwen_direct: original image plus fixed class prompt
methods.B_vace_text: first-frame VACE baseline plus ordinary selector
methods.C_proxy_qwen: coupled final proxy plus Qwen appearance editing
methods.D_independent_vace: independent source repair and target motion plus ordinary selector
methods.E_coupled_vace: shared source-target material state plus ordinary selector
methods.F_event_selection: reuse E video with event-aware selector; no new generation

qwen.availability: complete runnable base not found; keep as unavailable comparison rather than substituting another method

appearance_refinement.placement: after selected frame and before final image

claim_limit: A one-seed development smoke can verify interfaces and artifact completeness only; it cannot establish superiority, generalization, physical correctness, or photo realism.
